// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array        // 추가 환경 변수
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

// ==================== 출력 파싱 ====================

fn parse_test_output(stdout: string, stderr: string, exit_code: i32, lang: string, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 출력 파싱 (언어별)"
  do
    let combined = stdout + stderr

    if lang == "rust"
      return parse_rust_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return parse_go_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return parse_fl_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    // 기본: exit code만 확인
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: stdout,
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "Rust 요약 줄에서 특정 카운트 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; ..."
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)
      let last_part = arr_last_str(parts)
      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_go_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "go test -v 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "--- PASS: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- PASS:")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "--- FAIL: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- FAIL:")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_between(line, "--- FAIL: ", " (")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "PASS: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "PASS: ")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "FAIL: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "Tests: 10 passed, 2 failed"
      if str_contains(line, "Tests:") && str_contains(line, "passed")
        total = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed") + parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
        passed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed")
        failed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_summary_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "FreeLang 요약 줄에서 카운트 파싱"
  do
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before = str_before(line, label)
      let trimmed = str_trim(before)
      // 마지막 공백 이후 숫자
      if str_contains(trimmed, " ")
        let last = str_after_last(trimmed, " ")
        return parse_int_from_str(last)
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(trimmed)
    end
    return 0
end

// ==================== 저장소 클론/업데이트 ====================

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "저장소 클론"
  do
    let clone_url = gogs_url + "/" + owner + "/" + repo + ".git"
    let cmd = "git clone --depth=1 --branch " + branch +
              " '" + clone_url + "' '" + target_path + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("클론 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn checkout_patch_branch(repo_path: string, branch: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치 브랜치 체크아웃"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git checkout -b '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("체크아웃 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn write_patched_file(repo_path: string, file_path: string, content: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치된 파일 로컬에 쓰기"
  do
    let full_path = repo_path + "/" + file_path
    let result = file_write(full_path, content)
    return result
end

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어 (커버리지/병렬 옵션 포함)"

      if cfg.test_filter != ""

      cmd = cmd + " --summary-only 2>&1"
      return cmd

      cmd = cmd + " -- --test-threads=4"
    end

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -- --nocapture"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd

    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " -coverprofile=coverage.out"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -parallel 4"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter

    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd

  do
    let cmd = "python3 -m pytest"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -k '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing"
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -v"

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -n auto"  // pytest-xdist 필요

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd

        runner = runner + " --testNamePattern='" + cfg.test_filter + "'"

      if cfg.with_coverage
        runner = runner + " --coverage"
      end
    else if use_vitest
      runner = "npx vitest run"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        runner = runner + " -t '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
      end
    end

    return runner + " 2>&1"
end

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증 (Phase 2 강화)
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// 추가: Python(pytest), 커버리지, 병렬 테스트, 상세 실패 리포트
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang" | "python"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array,       // 추가 환경 변수
  with_coverage: bool,   // 커버리지 측정 여부
  verbose: bool,         // 상세 출력
  parallel: bool         // 병렬 실행 (지원 언어만)
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

// ==================== 출력 파싱 ====================

fn parse_test_output(stdout: string, stderr: string, exit_code: i32, lang: string, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 출력 파싱 (언어별)"
  do
    let combined = stdout + stderr

    if lang == "rust"
      return parse_rust_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return parse_go_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return parse_fl_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    // 기본: exit code만 확인
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: stdout,
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "Rust 요약 줄에서 특정 카운트 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; ..."
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)
      let last_part = arr_last_str(parts)
      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_go_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "go test -v 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "--- PASS: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- PASS:")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "--- FAIL: TestName (0.01s)"
      if str_starts_with(line, "--- FAIL:")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_between(line, "--- FAIL: ", " (")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 출력 파싱"
  do
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // "PASS: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "PASS: ")
        passed = passed + 1
        total = total + 1
      end

      // "FAIL: test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed = failed + 1
        total = total + 1
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAIL: ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "Tests: 10 passed, 2 failed"
      if str_contains(line, "Tests:") && str_contains(line, "passed")
        total = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed") + parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
        passed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "passed")
        failed = parse_fl_summary_count(line, "failed")
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_fl_summary_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "FreeLang 요약 줄에서 카운트 파싱"
  do
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before = str_before(line, label)
      let trimmed = str_trim(before)
      // 마지막 공백 이후 숫자
      if str_contains(trimmed, " ")
        let last = str_after_last(trimmed, " ")
        return parse_int_from_str(last)
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(trimmed)
    end
    return 0
end

// ==================== 저장소 클론/업데이트 ====================

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "저장소 클론"
  do
    let clone_url = gogs_url + "/" + owner + "/" + repo + ".git"
    let cmd = "git clone --depth=1 --branch " + branch +
              " '" + clone_url + "' '" + target_path + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("클론 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn checkout_patch_branch(repo_path: string, branch: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치 브랜치 체크아웃"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git checkout -b '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("체크아웃 실패: " + e)
    end
end

fn write_patched_file(repo_path: string, file_path: string, content: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치된 파일 로컬에 쓰기"
  do
    let full_path = repo_path + "/" + file_path
    let result = file_write(full_path, content)
    return result
end

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증 (Phase 2 강화)
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음
// 추가: Python(pytest), 커버리지, 병렬 테스트, 상세 실패 리포트
// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang" | "python"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array,       // 추가 환경 변수
  with_coverage: bool,   // 커버리지 측정 여부
  verbose: bool,         // 상세 출력
  parallel: bool         // 병렬 실행 (지원 언어만)
}

struct TestRunResult {
  passed: bool,
  exit_code: i32,
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  duration_ms: i32,
  tests_total: i32,
  tests_passed: i32,
  tests_failed: i32,
  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "python"
      return build_python_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "node" || cfg.lang == "javascript" || cfg.lang == "typescript"
      return build_node_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어 (커버리지/병렬 옵션 포함)"
  do
    if cfg.with_coverage
      // cargo llvm-cov 사용 (설치 필요)
      let cmd = "cargo llvm-cov"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        cmd = cmd + " --test " + cfg.test_filter
      end
      cmd = cmd + " --summary-only 2>&1"
      return cmd
    end

    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -- --test-threads=4"
    end

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -- --nocapture"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Go 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "go test ./..."

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " -coverprofile=coverage.out"
    end

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -parallel 4"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " -v 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "FreeLang 테스트 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "fl test"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " --filter " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " --verbose"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd
end

fn build_python_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Python pytest 명령어"
  do
    let cmd = "python3 -m pytest"

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " -k '" + cfg.test_filter + "'"
    end

    if cfg.with_coverage
      cmd = cmd + " --cov=. --cov-report=term-missing"

fn parse_test_output(stdout: string, stderr: string, exit_code: i32, lang: string, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 출력 파싱 (언어별)"
  do
    let combined = stdout + stderr

    if lang == "rust"
      return parse_rust_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "go"
      return parse_go_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    if lang == "freelang"
      return parse_fl_test_output(combined, exit_code, duration)
    end

    // 기본: exit code만 확인
    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: stdout,
      stderr: stderr,
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: 0,
      tests_passed: 0,
      tests_failed: 0,
      failed_tests: []
    }
end

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32
  intent "Rust 요약 줄에서 특정 카운트 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; ..."
    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)
      let last_part = arr_last_str(parts)
      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)
    end
    return 0
end

fn parse_go_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "go test -v 출력 파싱"

      // "--- PASS: TestName (0.01s)"

      tests_failed: failed,

    }

    return 0

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn parse_jest_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32

    end
    let before = str_trim(str_before(line, label))
    let result = ""
    let i = str_len(before) - 1
    while i >= 0
      let ch = str_char(before, i)
      if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
         ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
        result = ch + result
        i = i - 1
      else

      end
    end
    return parse_int_from_str(result)
end

// ============================================================
// test_runner.fl - 테스트 실행 & 결과 검증 (Phase 2 강화)
// exec() 기반 - 외부 라이브러리 없음

// ============================================================

struct TestRunConfig {
  repo_path: string,     // 로컬 클론 경로
  lang: string,          // "rust" | "go" | "freelang" | "python"
  test_filter: string,   // 특정 테스트만 실행 (빈 문자열이면 전체)
  timeout_sec: i32,
  env_vars: array,       // 추가 환경 변수

struct TestRunResult {

  failed_tests: array    // 실패한 테스트 이름 배열
}

// ==================== 메인 실행 ====================

fn run_tests(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> TestRunResult
  intent "테스트 실행 및 결과 파싱"
  do
    let cmd = build_test_command(cfg)
    let start_time = now_ms()

    let output = exec_with_timeout(cmd, cfg.repo_path, cfg.timeout_sec)
    let duration = now_ms() - start_time

    match output
      Ok(out) => {
        return parse_test_output(out.stdout, out.stderr, out.exit_code, cfg.lang, duration)
      }
      Err(e) => {
        return TestRunResult {
          passed: false,
          exit_code: -1,
          stdout: "",
          stderr: "실행 실패: " + e,
          duration_ms: duration,
          tests_total: 0,
          tests_passed: 0,
          tests_failed: 0,
          failed_tests: []
        }
      }
    end
end

fn build_test_command(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "언어별 테스트 명령어 생성"
  do
    if cfg.lang == "rust"
      return build_rust_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "go"
      return build_go_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "freelang"
      return build_fl_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "python"
      return build_python_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    if cfg.lang == "node" || cfg.lang == "javascript" || cfg.lang == "typescript"
      return build_node_test_cmd(cfg)
    end

    // 기본: Makefile 있으면 make test
    return "make test 2>&1"
end

fn build_rust_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Rust 테스트 명령어 (커버리지/병렬 옵션 포함)"
  do
    if cfg.with_coverage
      // cargo llvm-cov 사용 (설치 필요)
      let cmd = "cargo llvm-cov"
      if cfg.test_filter != ""
        cmd = cmd + " --test " + cfg.test_filter
      end
      cmd = cmd + " --summary-only 2>&1"
      return cmd
    end

    let cmd = "cargo test"

    if cfg.parallel
      cmd = cmd + " -- --test-threads=4"
    end

    if cfg.test_filter != ""
      cmd = cmd + " " + cfg.test_filter
    end

    if cfg.verbose
      cmd = cmd + " -- --nocapture"
    end

    cmd = cmd + " 2>&1"
    return cmd

fn build_go_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string

      cmd = cmd + " -run " + cfg.test_filter

    if cfg.with_coverage

fn build_fl_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string

fn build_node_test_cmd(cfg: TestRunConfig) -> string
  intent "Node.js 테스트 명령어 (Jest/Vitest 자동 감지)"
  do
    // package.json에서 테스트 스크립트 감지
    let use_jest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.js") ||
                   file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/jest.config.ts")
    let use_vitest = file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.ts") ||
                     file_exists(cfg.repo_path + "/vitest.config.js")

    if use_jest

      if cfg.with_coverage

fn parse_rust_test_output(output: string, exit_code: i32, duration: i32) -> TestRunResult
  intent "cargo test 출력 파싱"
  do
    // "test result: FAILED. 3 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out"
    let total = 0
    let passed = 0
    let failed = 0
    let failed_tests = []
    let lines = str_split_lines(output)
    let i = 0
    let tlen = arr_len(lines)

    while i < tlen
      let line = arr_get(lines, i)

      // 결과 요약 줄 파싱
      if str_starts_with(line, "test result:")
        passed = parse_rust_count(line, " passed")
        failed = parse_rust_count(line, " failed")
        total = passed + failed
      end

      // 실패한 테스트 목록: "FAILED tests::test_name"
      if str_starts_with(line, "FAILED ")
        let test_name = str_after(line, "FAILED ")
        failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, str_trim(test_name))
      end

      // "test tests::test_name ... FAILED"
      if str_ends_with(str_trim(line), "FAILED") && str_starts_with(line, "test ")
        let test_name = str_between(line, "test ", " ...")
        if test_name != ""
          failed_tests = arr_push(failed_tests, test_name)
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return TestRunResult {
      passed: exit_code == 0 && failed == 0,
      exit_code: exit_code,
      stdout: output,
      stderr: "",
      duration_ms: duration,
      tests_total: total,
      tests_passed: passed,
      tests_failed: failed,
      failed_tests: failed_tests
    }
end

fn parse_rust_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32

    if str_contains(line, label)
      let before_label = str_before(line, label)
      let parts = str_split_by_space(before_label)

      return parse_int_from_str(last_part)

end

fn parse_fl_summary_count(line: string, label: string) -> i32

fn clone_repo(gogs_url: string, owner: string, repo: string, branch: string, target_path: string) -> Result<void, string>

    let cmd = "git clone --depth=1 --branch " + branch +
              " '" + clone_url + "' '" + target_path + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("클론 실패: " + e)

fn checkout_patch_branch(repo_path: string, branch: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "패치 브랜치 체크아웃"
  do
    let cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git checkout -b '" + branch + "' 2>&1"

fn commit_and_push(repo_path: string, branch: string, message: string, gogs_url: string, token: string) -> Result<string, string>
  intent "변경사항 커밋 + 원격 Push"
  do
    // 1. git add
    let add_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git add -A 2>&1"
    match exec(add_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git add 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 2. git commit
    let commit_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && " +
                     "git -c user.email='heal-agent@freelang.dev' " +
                     "-c user.name='Self-Healing Agent' " +
                     "commit -m '" + shell_escape_single(message) + "' 2>&1"

    match exec(commit_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git commit 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    // 3. SHA 가져오기
    let sha_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git rev-parse HEAD 2>&1"
    let sha = ""
    match exec(sha_cmd)
      Ok(s) => sha = str_trim(s)
      Err(_) => sha = "unknown"
    end

    // 4. git push
    let push_cmd = "cd '" + repo_path + "' && git push origin '" + branch + "' 2>&1"
    match exec(push_cmd)
      Err(e) => return Err("git push 실패: " + e)
      Ok(_) => {}
    end

    return Ok(sha)
end

// ==================== exec 헬퍼 ====================

struct ExecOutput {
  stdout: string,
  stderr: string,
  exit_code: i32
}

fn exec_with_timeout(cmd: string, work_dir: string, timeout_sec: i32) -> Result<ExecOutput, string>
  intent "타임아웃 있는 명령 실행"
  do
    // timeout 명령으로 래핑
    let full_cmd = "cd '" + work_dir + "' && " +
                   "timeout " + int_to_str(timeout_sec) +
                   " sh -c '" + shell_escape_single(cmd) + "' 2>&1; echo \"EXIT:$?\""

    match exec(full_cmd)
      Ok(output) => {
        // "EXIT:0" 패턴으로 exit code 추출
        let exit_code = 0
        if str_contains(output, "EXIT:")
          let exit_str = str_after(output, "EXIT:")
          exit_code = parse_int_from_str(str_trim(exit_str))
        end

        let clean_output = str_before(output, "\nEXIT:")

        return Ok(ExecOutput {
          stdout: clean_output,
          stderr: "",
          exit_code: exit_code
        })
      }
      Err(e) => return Err(e)
    end
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn arr_last_str(arr: array) -> string
  intent "배열의 마지막 문자열 요소"
  do
    let total = arr_len(arr)
    if total == 0
      return ""
    end
    return arr_get(arr, total - 1)
end

fn str_split_by_space(s: string) -> array
  intent "공백으로 문자열 분할"
  do
    let result = []
    let current = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == " " || ch == "\t"
        if str_len(current) > 0
          result = arr_push(result, current)
          current = ""
        end
      else
        current = current + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    if str_len(current) > 0
      result = arr_push(result, current)
    end

    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'"
        result = result + "'\\''"
      else
        result = result + ch
      end
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

      analysis: "",
      diff_text: "",
      patch_branch: "",
      pr_number: 0,
      pr_url: "",
      start_time: now_unix(),
      end_time: 0,
      failure_reason: ""
    }

    // 재시도 루프
    let result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: 0,
      duration_sec: 0,
      summary: ""
    }

    while session.attempt <= session.max_attempts
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "/" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts))

      let attempt_result = heal_attempt(session, cfg)

      if attempt_result.success
        result = HealResult {
          success: true,
          session_id: session_id,
          pr_url: attempt_result.pr_url,
          attempts: session.attempt,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
          summary: "자가치유 성공: " + attempt_result.pr_url
        }

        // 메모리에 성공 기록
        memory_record_success(session, cfg)

        print("[Heal] 성공! PR: " + attempt_result.pr_url)
        return result
      end

      // 실패: 다음 시도를 위해 분석 조정
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + " 실패: " + attempt_result.reason)
      session.attempt = session.attempt + 1

      // 실패한 패치 브랜치 정리
      if session.patch_branch != ""
        let gogs = GogsClient {
          base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
          token: cfg.gogs_token,
          owner: cfg.gogs_owner
        }
        gogs_delete_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch)
      end
    end

    // 모든 시도 실패
    result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: session.max_attempts,
      duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
      summary: "자가치유 실패 (" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "번 시도 후): " + session.failure_reason
    }

    memory_record_failure(session, cfg)
    print("[Heal] 최종 실패: " + result.summary)

    return result
end

struct AttemptResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_url: string,
  reason: string
}

fn heal_attempt(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> AttemptResult
  intent "단일 자가치유 시도"
  do
    let event = session.event
    let gogs = GogsClient {
      base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
      token: cfg.gogs_token,
      owner: cfg.gogs_owner
    }

    // ─── Step 1: 로그 파싱 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 1] 실패 로그 파싱 중...")
    session.status = "analyzing"

    let parse_result = parse_failure_log(event)

    if !parse_result.success || arr_len(parse_result.errors) == 0
      session.failure_reason = "로그 파싱 실패"
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "로그 파싱 실패" }
    end

    session.parsed_error = arr_get(parse_result.errors, 0)
    print("[Step 1] 완료: " + parse_result.summary)

    // ─── Step 2: 파일 읽기 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 2] 원본 파일 읽기...")
    let file_content = ""

    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      let file_result = gogs_get_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
      match file_result
        Ok(content) => file_content = content
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Step 2] 파일 읽기 실패 (계속): " + e)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 3: Claude 에러 분석 ────────────────────────
    print("[Step 3] Claude로 에러 분석 중...")

    let analyze_resp = claude_analyze_error(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.parsed_error,
      file_content
    )

    if !analyze_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "Claude 분석 실패: " + analyze_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    session.analysis = analyze_resp.content
    print("[Step 3] 분석 완료 (토큰: " + int_to_str(analyze_resp.output_tokens) + ")")

    // ─── Step 4: 패치 생성 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 4] 패치 생성 중...")
    session.status = "patching"

    let patch_resp = claude_generate_patch(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.analysis,
      file_content,
      session.parsed_error
    )

    if !patch_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "패치 생성 실패: " + patch_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    // diff 추출
    let diff_result = extract_diff_from_response(patch_resp.content)
    match diff_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 추출 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(diff) => {
        session.diff_text = diff
      }
    end

    // diff 파싱
    let patch_parse_result = parse_unified_diff(session.diff_text)
    match patch_parse_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 파싱 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(patch) => {
        // 패치 검증
        let validate_result = validate_patch(patch, file_content)
        match validate_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 실패: " + e + " (계속 시도)")
            // 검증 실패해도 시도는 계속
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 성공")
          }
        end

        // 패치 적용
        let apply_result = apply_patch(file_content, patch)

        if !apply_result.success
          session.failure_reason = "패치 적용 실패: " + apply_result.error_msg
          return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
        end

        print("[Step 4] 패치 적용: " + patch_summary(patch))

        // ─── Step 5: 패치 브랜치 생성 ───────────────────────
        print("[Step 5] 패치 브랜치 생성...")

        session.patch_branch = "auto-heal/" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8) +
                               "-attempt-" + int_to_str(session.attempt)

        let branch_result = gogs_create_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch, event.branch)
        match branch_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "브랜치 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 5] 브랜치 생성: " + session.patch_branch)
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 파일 업로드 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 6] 패치 파일 업로드...")

        let sha_result = gogs_get_file_sha(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
        let original_sha = ""
        match sha_result
          Ok(s) => original_sha = s
          Err(_) => {}  // 파일이 새로 생성되는 경우
        end

        let commit_msg = "[auto-heal] Fix " + session.parsed_error.error_type +
                        " in " + session.parsed_error.file_path

        let upload_result = ""
        if original_sha != ""
          let update_r = gogs_update_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path,
                                          apply_result.patched_content, commit_msg,
                                          original_sha, session.patch_branch)
          match update_r
            Err(e) => {
              session.failure_reason = "파일 업데이트 실패: " + e
              return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
            }
            Ok(commit) => {
              upload_result = commit.sha
              print("[Step 6] 파일 업데이트: " + str_substr(commit.sha, 0, 8))
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 7: 테스트 검증 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 7] 패치 후 테스트 실행...")
        session.status = "testing"

        let test_cfg = TestRunConfig {
          repo_path: "/tmp/heal-" + session.id,
          lang: session.parsed_error.lang,
          test_filter: session.parsed_error.test_name,
          timeout_sec: cfg.test_timeout_sec,
          env_vars: []
        }

        // 패치 브랜치 클론
        let clone_result = clone_repo(cfg.gogs_url, cfg.gogs_owner, event.repo,
                                      session.patch_branch, test_cfg.repo_path)
        match clone_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 7] 클론 실패 (테스트 스킵): " + e)
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            let test_result = run_tests(test_cfg)

            if !test_result.passed
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 실패 (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_failed) + "개 실패)")
              // 테스트 실패해도 PR은 생성 (리뷰어가 판단)
            else
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 통과! (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_total) + ")")
            end
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 8: PR 생성 ────────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 8] Pull Request 생성...")

        let pr_title = build_heal_pr_title(session.parsed_error, session.attempt)
        let pr_body = build_heal_pr_body(event, session.parsed_error, session.analysis, patch_summary(patch))

        let pr_result = gogs_create_pr(gogs, event.repo, pr_title, pr_body,
                                       session.patch_branch, event.branch)

        match pr_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "PR 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(pr) => {
            session.pr_number = pr.number
            session.pr_url = pr.html_url
            session.status = "pr_created"

            print("[Step 8] PR 생성: #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " - " + pr.html_url)

            // ─── Step 9: Proof Score 계산 ─────────────────────
            let proof_score = calc_proof_score(session, parse_result)
            print("[ProofScore] " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100")

            return AttemptResult {
              success: true,
              pr_url: pr.html_url,
              reason: ""
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "알 수 없는 오류" }
end

// ==================== Proof Score ====================

fn calc_proof_score(session: HealSession, parse_result: ParseResult) -> i32
  intent "자가치유 품질 점수 계산 (0-100)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 파싱 성공 +20
    if parse_result.success
      score = score + 20
    end

    // 파싱 신뢰도 반영 +20
    score = score + (parse_result.confidence / 5)

    // 파일 위치 특정 +15
    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      score = score + 15
    end

    // 줄 번호 특정 +10
    if session.parsed_error.line_num > 0
      score = score + 10
    end

    // PR 생성 성공 +25
    if session.pr_number > 0
      score = score + 25
    end

    // 1번에 성공 +10
    if session.attempt == 1
      score = score + 10
    end

    if score > 100
      return 100
    end

    return score
end

// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================

fn memory_record_success(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "성공한 자가치유 기록"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"success\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "," +
      "\"pr_url\":\"" + session.pr_url + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

fn memory_record_failure(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "실패한 자가치유 기록 (학습용)"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"failed\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "," +
      "\"reason\":\"" + json_escape(session.failure_reason) + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

// ============================================================
// heal_loop.fl - Self-Healing 메인 오케스트레이터 (Phase 2)
// 전체 자가치유 파이프라인 (감지→분석→패치→검증→PR)

// 자가치유 상태 머신
struct HealSession {
  id: string,
  event: FailureEvent,
  status: string,         // "started" | "analyzing" | "patching" | "verifying" | "testing" | "pr_created" | "done" | "failed"
  attempt: i32,
  max_attempts: i32,

}

  duration_sec: i32,
  summary: string
}

// ==================== 메인 진입점 ====================

fn heal(event: FailureEvent, cfg: AgentConfig) -> HealResult
  intent "자가치유 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    let session_id = "heal_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + "_" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8)

    print("[Heal] 세션 시작: " + session_id)
    print("[Heal] 저장소: " + event.repo + " / 브랜치: " + event.branch)

    let session = HealSession {
      id: session_id,
      event: event,
      status: "started",
      attempt: 1,
      max_attempts: cfg.max_retries,
      parsed_error: ParsedError { error_type: "", file_path: "", line_num: 0, col_num: 0, error_msg: "", context: "", test_name: "", lang: "" },
      analysis: "",
      diff_text: "",
      patch_branch: "",
      pr_number: 0,
      pr_url: "",
      start_time: now_unix(),
      end_time: 0,
      failure_reason: ""
    }

    // 재시도 루프
    let result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: 0,
      duration_sec: 0,
      summary: ""
    }

    while session.attempt <= session.max_attempts
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "/" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts))

      let attempt_result = heal_attempt(session, cfg)

      if attempt_result.success
        result = HealResult {
          success: true,
          session_id: session_id,
          pr_url: attempt_result.pr_url,
          attempts: session.attempt,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
          summary: "자가치유 성공: " + attempt_result.pr_url
        }

        // 메모리에 성공 기록
        memory_record_success(session, cfg)

        print("[Heal] 성공! PR: " + attempt_result.pr_url)
        return result
      end

      // 실패: 다음 시도를 위해 분석 조정
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + " 실패: " + attempt_result.reason)
      session.attempt = session.attempt + 1

      // 실패한 패치 브랜치 정리
      if session.patch_branch != ""
        let gogs = GogsClient {
          base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
          token: cfg.gogs_token,
          owner: cfg.gogs_owner
        }
        gogs_delete_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch)
      end
    end

    // 모든 시도 실패
    result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: session.max_attempts,
      duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
      summary: "자가치유 실패 (" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "번 시도 후): " + session.failure_reason
    }

    memory_record_failure(session, cfg)
    print("[Heal] 최종 실패: " + result.summary)

    return result
end

struct AttemptResult {

fn heal_attempt(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> AttemptResult
  intent "단일 자가치유 시도"
  do
    let event = session.event
    let gogs = GogsClient {
      base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
      token: cfg.gogs_token,
      owner: cfg.gogs_owner
    }

    // ─── Step 1: 로그 파싱 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 1] 실패 로그 파싱 중...")

      session.failure_reason = "로그 파싱 실패"

    end

    session.parsed_error = arr_get(parse_result.errors, 0)
    print("[Step 1] 완료: " + parse_result.summary)

    // ─── Step 2: 파일 읽기 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 2] 원본 파일 읽기...")
    let file_content = ""

    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      let file_result = gogs_get_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
      match file_result
        Ok(content) => file_content = content
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Step 2] 파일 읽기 실패 (계속): " + e)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 3: Claude 에러 분석 ────────────────────────
    print("[Step 3] Claude로 에러 분석 중...")

    let analyze_resp = claude_analyze_error(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.parsed_error,
      file_content
    )

    if !analyze_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "Claude 분석 실패: " + analyze_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    session.analysis = analyze_resp.content
    print("[Step 3] 분석 완료 (토큰: " + int_to_str(analyze_resp.output_tokens) + ")")

    // ─── Step 4: 패치 생성 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 4] 패치 생성 중...")
    session.status = "patching"

    let patch_resp = claude_generate_patch(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.analysis,
      file_content,
      session.parsed_error
    )

    if !patch_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "패치 생성 실패: " + patch_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    // diff 추출
    let diff_result = extract_diff_from_response(patch_resp.content)
    match diff_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 추출 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(diff) => {
        session.diff_text = diff
      }
    end

    // diff 파싱
    let patch_parse_result = parse_unified_diff(session.diff_text)
    match patch_parse_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 파싱 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(patch) => {
        // 패치 검증
        let validate_result = validate_patch(patch, file_content)
        match validate_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 실패: " + e + " (계속 시도)")
            // 검증 실패해도 시도는 계속
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 성공")
          }
        end

        // 패치 적용
        let apply_result = apply_patch(file_content, patch)

        if !apply_result.success
          session.failure_reason = "패치 적용 실패: " + apply_result.error_msg
          return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
        end

        print("[Step 4] 패치 적용: " + patch_summary(patch))

        // ─── Step 5: 패치 브랜치 생성 ───────────────────────
        print("[Step 5] 패치 브랜치 생성...")

        session.patch_branch = "auto-heal/" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8) +
                               "-attempt-" + int_to_str(session.attempt)

        let branch_result = gogs_create_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch, event.branch)
        match branch_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "브랜치 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 5] 브랜치 생성: " + session.patch_branch)
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 파일 업로드 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 6] 패치 파일 업로드...")

        let sha_result = gogs_get_file_sha(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
        let original_sha = ""
        match sha_result
          Ok(s) => original_sha = s
          Err(_) => {}  // 파일이 새로 생성되는 경우
        end

        let commit_msg = "[auto-heal] Fix " + session.parsed_error.error_type +
                        " in " + session.parsed_error.file_path

        let upload_result = ""
        if original_sha != ""
          let update_r = gogs_update_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path,
                                          apply_result.patched_content, commit_msg,
                                          original_sha, session.patch_branch)
          match update_r
            Err(e) => {
              session.failure_reason = "파일 업데이트 실패: " + e
              return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
            }
            Ok(commit) => {
              upload_result = commit.sha
              print("[Step 6] 파일 업데이트: " + str_substr(commit.sha, 0, 8))
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 7: 테스트 검증 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 7] 패치 후 테스트 실행...")
        session.status = "testing"

        let test_cfg = TestRunConfig {
          repo_path: "/tmp/heal-" + session.id,
          lang: session.parsed_error.lang,
          test_filter: session.parsed_error.test_name,
          timeout_sec: cfg.test_timeout_sec,
          env_vars: []
        }

        // 패치 브랜치 클론
        let clone_result = clone_repo(cfg.gogs_url, cfg.gogs_owner, event.repo,
                                      session.patch_branch, test_cfg.repo_path)
        match clone_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 7] 클론 실패 (테스트 스킵): " + e)
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            let test_result = run_tests(test_cfg)

            if !test_result.passed
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 실패 (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_failed) + "개 실패)")
              // 테스트 실패해도 PR은 생성 (리뷰어가 판단)
            else
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 통과! (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_total) + ")")
            end
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 8: PR 생성 ────────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 8] Pull Request 생성...")

        let pr_title = build_heal_pr_title(session.parsed_error, session.attempt)
        let pr_body = build_heal_pr_body(event, session.parsed_error, session.analysis, patch_summary(patch))

        let pr_result = gogs_create_pr(gogs, event.repo, pr_title, pr_body,
                                       session.patch_branch, event.branch)

        match pr_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "PR 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(pr) => {
            session.pr_number = pr.number
            session.pr_url = pr.html_url
            session.status = "pr_created"

            print("[Step 8] PR 생성: #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " - " + pr.html_url)

            // ─── Step 9: Proof Score 계산 ─────────────────────
            let proof_score = calc_proof_score(session, parse_result)
            print("[ProofScore] " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100")

            return AttemptResult {
              success: true,
              pr_url: pr.html_url,
              reason: ""
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "알 수 없는 오류" }
end

// ==================== Proof Score ====================

fn calc_proof_score(session: HealSession, parse_result: ParseResult) -> i32
  intent "자가치유 품질 점수 계산 (0-100)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 파싱 성공 +20
    if parse_result.success
      score = score + 20
    end

    // 파싱 신뢰도 반영 +20
    score = score + (parse_result.confidence / 5)

    // 파일 위치 특정 +15
    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      score = score + 15
    end

    // 줄 번호 특정 +10
    if session.parsed_error.line_num > 0
      score = score + 10
    end

    // PR 생성 성공 +25
    if session.pr_number > 0
      score = score + 25
    end

    // 1번에 성공 +10
    if session.attempt == 1
      score = score + 10
    end

    if score > 100
      return 100
    end

    return score
end

// ==================== 메모리 기록 ====================

fn memory_record_success(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "성공한 자가치유 기록"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"success\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "," +
      "\"pr_url\":\"" + session.pr_url + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

fn memory_record_failure(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> void
  intent "실패한 자가치유 기록 (학습용)"
  do
    let record = "{" +
      "\"id\":\"" + session.id + "\"," +
      "\"status\":\"failed\"," +
      "\"repo\":\"" + session.event.repo + "\"," +
      "\"error_type\":\"" + session.parsed_error.error_type + "\"," +
      "\"lang\":\"" + session.parsed_error.lang + "\"," +
      "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "," +
      "\"reason\":\"" + json_escape(session.failure_reason) + "\"," +
      "\"timestamp\":" + int_to_str(session.start_time) +
    "}"

    append_to_file(cfg.memory_path, record + "\n")
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end
