// ============================================================
// heal_loop.fl - Self-Healing 메인 오케스트레이터 (Phase 2)
// 전체 자가치유 파이프라인 (감지→분석→패치→검증→PR)
// Phase 2 추가: analyzer + verifier + retry_strategy 통합
// ============================================================

// 자가치유 상태 머신
struct HealSession {
  id: string,
  event: FailureEvent,
  status: string,         // "started" | "analyzing" | "patching" | "verifying" | "testing" | "pr_created" | "done" | "failed"
  attempt: i32,
  max_attempts: i32,
  parsed_error: ParsedError,
  analysis: AnalysisResult,   // Phase 2: 구조화된 분석
  diff_text: string,
  patch_branch: string,
  pr_number: i32,
  pr_url: string,
  start_time: i64,
  end_time: i64,
  failure_reason: string,
  failure_memory: FailureMemory  // Phase 2: 재시도 메모리
}

struct HealResult {
  success: bool,
  session_id: string,
  pr_url: string,
  attempts: i32,
  duration_sec: i32,
  summary: string
}

// ==================== 메인 진입점 ====================

fn heal(event: FailureEvent, cfg: AgentConfig) -> HealResult
  intent "자가치유 전체 파이프라인 실행"
  do
    let session_id = "heal_" + int_to_str(now_unix()) + "_" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8)

    print("[Heal] 세션 시작: " + session_id)
    print("[Heal] 저장소: " + event.repo + " / 브랜치: " + event.branch)

    let session = HealSession {
      id: session_id,
      event: event,
      status: "started",
      attempt: 1,
      max_attempts: cfg.max_retries,
      parsed_error: ParsedError { error_type: "", file_path: "", line_num: 0, col_num: 0, error_msg: "", context: "", test_name: "", lang: "" },
      analysis: AnalysisResult { root_cause: "", fix_strategy: "", fix_type: "", affected_lines: [], related_files: [], confidence: 0, severity: "low", category: "unknown", suggestions: [] },
      diff_text: "",
      patch_branch: "",
      pr_number: 0,
      pr_url: "",
      start_time: now_unix(),
      end_time: 0,
      failure_reason: "",
      failure_memory: memory_init()
    }

    // 재시도 루프
    let result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: 0,
      duration_sec: 0,
      summary: ""
    }

    while session.attempt <= session.max_attempts
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + "/" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts))

      let attempt_result = heal_attempt(session, cfg)

      if attempt_result.success
        result = HealResult {
          success: true,
          session_id: session_id,
          pr_url: attempt_result.pr_url,
          attempts: session.attempt,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
          summary: "자가치유 성공: " + attempt_result.pr_url
        }

        // 메모리에 성공 기록
        memory_record_success(session, cfg)

        print("[Heal] 성공! PR: " + attempt_result.pr_url)
        return result
      end

      // 실패: 다음 시도를 위해 분석 조정
      print("[Heal] 시도 " + int_to_str(session.attempt) + " 실패: " + attempt_result.reason)
      session.attempt = session.attempt + 1

      // 실패한 패치 브랜치 정리
      if session.patch_branch != ""
        let gogs = GogsClient {
          base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
          token: cfg.gogs_token,
          owner: cfg.gogs_owner
        }
        gogs_delete_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch)
      end
    end

    // 모든 시도 실패
    result = HealResult {
      success: false,
      session_id: session_id,
      pr_url: "",
      attempts: session.max_attempts,
      duration_sec: now_unix() - session.start_time,
      summary: "자가치유 실패 (" + int_to_str(session.max_attempts) + "번 시도 후): " + session.failure_reason
    }

    memory_record_failure(session, cfg)
    print("[Heal] 최종 실패: " + result.summary)

    return result
end

struct AttemptResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_url: string,
  reason: string
}

fn heal_attempt(session: HealSession, cfg: AgentConfig) -> AttemptResult
  intent "단일 자가치유 시도"
  do
    let event = session.event
    let gogs = GogsClient {
      base_url: cfg.gogs_url,
      token: cfg.gogs_token,
      owner: cfg.gogs_owner
    }

    // ─── Step 1: 로그 파싱 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 1] 실패 로그 파싱 중...")
    session.status = "analyzing"

    let parse_result = parse_failure_log(event)

    if !parse_result.success || arr_len(parse_result.errors) == 0
      session.failure_reason = "로그 파싱 실패"
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "로그 파싱 실패" }
    end

    session.parsed_error = arr_get(parse_result.errors, 0)
    print("[Step 1] 완료: " + parse_result.summary)

    // ─── Step 2: 파일 읽기 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 2] 원본 파일 읽기...")
    let file_content = ""

    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      let file_result = gogs_get_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
      match file_result
        Ok(content) => file_content = content
        Err(e) => {
          print("[Step 2] 파일 읽기 실패 (계속): " + e)
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 3: Claude 에러 분석 ────────────────────────
    print("[Step 3] Claude로 에러 분석 중...")

    let analyze_resp = claude_analyze_error(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.parsed_error,
      file_content
    )

    if !analyze_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "Claude 분석 실패: " + analyze_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    session.analysis = analyze_resp.content
    print("[Step 3] 분석 완료 (토큰: " + int_to_str(analyze_resp.output_tokens) + ")")

    // ─── Step 4: 패치 생성 ───────────────────────────────
    print("[Step 4] 패치 생성 중...")
    session.status = "patching"

    let patch_resp = claude_generate_patch(
      cfg.claude_api_key,
      cfg.claude_model,
      session.analysis,
      file_content,
      session.parsed_error
    )

    if !patch_resp.success
      session.failure_reason = "패치 생성 실패: " + patch_resp.error_msg
      return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
    end

    // diff 추출
    let diff_result = extract_diff_from_response(patch_resp.content)
    match diff_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 추출 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(diff) => {
        session.diff_text = diff
      }
    end

    // diff 파싱
    let patch_parse_result = parse_unified_diff(session.diff_text)
    match patch_parse_result
      Err(e) => {
        session.failure_reason = "diff 파싱 실패: " + e
        return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
      }
      Ok(patch) => {
        // 패치 검증
        let validate_result = validate_patch(patch, file_content)
        match validate_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 실패: " + e + " (계속 시도)")
            // 검증 실패해도 시도는 계속
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 4] 패치 검증 성공")
          }
        end

        // 패치 적용
        let apply_result = apply_patch(file_content, patch)

        if !apply_result.success
          session.failure_reason = "패치 적용 실패: " + apply_result.error_msg
          return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
        end

        print("[Step 4] 패치 적용: " + patch_summary(patch))

        // ─── Step 5: 패치 브랜치 생성 ───────────────────────
        print("[Step 5] 패치 브랜치 생성...")

        session.patch_branch = "auto-heal/" + str_substr(event.commit_sha, 0, 8) +
                               "-attempt-" + int_to_str(session.attempt)

        let branch_result = gogs_create_branch(gogs, event.repo, session.patch_branch, event.branch)
        match branch_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "브랜치 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            print("[Step 5] 브랜치 생성: " + session.patch_branch)
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 6: 파일 업로드 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 6] 패치 파일 업로드...")

        let sha_result = gogs_get_file_sha(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path, event.branch)
        let original_sha = ""
        match sha_result
          Ok(s) => original_sha = s
          Err(_) => {}  // 파일이 새로 생성되는 경우
        end

        let commit_msg = "[auto-heal] Fix " + session.parsed_error.error_type +
                        " in " + session.parsed_error.file_path

        let upload_result = ""
        if original_sha != ""
          let update_r = gogs_update_file(gogs, event.repo, session.parsed_error.file_path,
                                          apply_result.patched_content, commit_msg,
                                          original_sha, session.patch_branch)
          match update_r
            Err(e) => {
              session.failure_reason = "파일 업데이트 실패: " + e
              return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
            }
            Ok(commit) => {
              upload_result = commit.sha
              print("[Step 6] 파일 업데이트: " + str_substr(commit.sha, 0, 8))
            }
          end
        end

        // ─── Step 7: 테스트 검증 ────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 7] 패치 후 테스트 실행...")
        session.status = "testing"

        let test_cfg = TestRunConfig {
          repo_path: "/tmp/heal-" + session.id,
          lang: session.parsed_error.lang,
          test_filter: session.parsed_error.test_name,
          timeout_sec: cfg.test_timeout_sec,
          env_vars: []
        }

        // 패치 브랜치 클론
        let clone_result = clone_repo(cfg.gogs_url, cfg.gogs_owner, event.repo,
                                      session.patch_branch, test_cfg.repo_path)
        match clone_result
          Err(e) => {
            print("[Step 7] 클론 실패 (테스트 스킵): " + e)
          }
          Ok(_) => {
            let test_result = run_tests(test_cfg)

            if !test_result.passed
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 실패 (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_failed) + "개 실패)")
              // 테스트 실패해도 PR은 생성 (리뷰어가 판단)
            else
              print("[Step 7] 테스트 통과! (" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(test_result.tests_total) + ")")
            end
          }
        end

        // ─── Step 8: PR 생성 ────────────────────────────────
        print("[Step 8] Pull Request 생성...")

        let pr_title = build_heal_pr_title(session.parsed_error, session.attempt)
        let pr_body = build_heal_pr_body(event, session.parsed_error, session.analysis, patch_summary(patch))

        let pr_result = gogs_create_pr(gogs, event.repo, pr_title, pr_body,
                                       session.patch_branch, event.branch)

        match pr_result
          Err(e) => {
            session.failure_reason = "PR 생성 실패: " + e
            return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: session.failure_reason }
          }
          Ok(pr) => {
            session.pr_number = pr.number
            session.pr_url = pr.html_url
            session.status = "pr_created"

            print("[Step 8] PR 생성: #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " - " + pr.html_url)

            // ─── Step 9: Proof Score 계산 ─────────────────────
            let proof_score = calc_proof_score(session, parse_result)
            print("[ProofScore] " + int_to_str(proof_score) + "/100")

            return AttemptResult {
              success: true,
              pr_url: pr.html_url,
              reason: ""
            }
          }
        end
      }
    end

    return AttemptResult { success: false, pr_url: "", reason: "알 수 없는 오류" }
end

// ==================== Proof Score ====================

fn calc_proof_score(session: HealSession, parse_result: ParseResult) -> i32
  intent "자가치유 품질 점수 계산 (0-100)"
  do
    let score = 0

    // 파싱 성공 +20
    if parse_result.success
      score = score + 20
    end

    // 파싱 신뢰도 반영 +20
    score = score + (parse_result.confidence / 5)

    // 파일 위치 특정 +15
    if session.parsed_error.file_path != ""
      score = score + 15
    end

    // 줄 번호 특정 +10
    if session.parsed_error.line_num > 0
      score = score + 10
    end

    // PR 생성 성공 +25
    if session.pr_number > 0
      score = score + 25
    end

    // 1번에 성공 +10
    if session.attempt == 1
      score = score + 10
    end

    if score > 100
      return 100
    end

    return score
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

fn run_all_tests() -> void
  do
    let tests_analyzer = [
      ["분석 JSON 완전 파싱",               test_parse_analysis_json_full()],
      ["Markdown 안 JSON 파싱",            test_parse_analysis_json_in_markdown()],
      ["panic → critical 심각도",          test_infer_severity_panic()],
      ["type → high 심각도",               test_infer_severity_type()],
      ["type 카테고리 추론",                test_infer_category_type()],
      ["컴파일 에러 우선순위",              test_error_priority_compile_first()],
      ["에러 랭킹 순서",                   test_rank_errors_order()],
      ["정수 배열 JSON 파싱",              test_json_int_array()],
      ["문자열 배열 JSON 파싱",            test_json_str_array()]
    ]

    let tests_verifier = [
      ["회귀 없음 (완전 수정)",            test_analyze_regression_no_regression()],
      ["회귀 감지",                        test_analyze_regression_detected()],
      ["부분 수정 회귀",                   test_analyze_regression_partial_fix()],
      ["대상 테스트 수정 확인",            test_is_target_test_fixed()],
      ["검증 JSON 파싱 (성공)",            test_parse_verify_json()],
      ["검증 JSON 파싱 (실패)",            test_parse_verify_json_false()]
    ]

    let tests_strategy = [
      ["1차 minimal 전략",                 test_strategy_attempt_1_minimal()],
      ["2차 contextual 전략",              test_strategy_attempt_2_contextual()],
      ["3차 aggressive 전략",              test_strategy_attempt_3_aggressive()],
      ["시도별 온도 상승",                 test_strategy_higher_temp_later()],
      ["실패 메모리 추가",                 test_memory_add_failure()],
      ["실패 이유 추출 (문법)",            test_failure_reason_from_verify_syntax()],
      ["실패 이유 추출 (회귀)",            test_failure_reason_from_verify_regression()],
      ["함수 시작 탐색",                   test_find_function_start()],
      ["ProofScore v2 계산",              test_proof_score_v2_components()]
    ]

    let all_groups = [
      ["Analyzer", tests_analyzer],
      ["Verifier", tests_verifier],
      ["RetryStrategy", tests_strategy]
    ]

    let total_passed = 0
    let total_failed = 0

    print("=== Heal Loop Integration Tests (Phase 2) ===\n")

    let gi = 0
    let gn = arr_len(all_groups)

    while gi < gn
      let group = arr_get(all_groups, gi)
      let group_name = arr_get(group, 0)
      let group_tests = arr_get(group, 1)
      let gcount = arr_len(group_tests)

      print("[" + group_name + "]")

      let i = 0
      while i < gcount
        let test = arr_get(group_tests, i)
        let name = arr_get(test, 0)
        let result = arr_get(test, 1)

        if result
          print("  ✅ PASS: " + name)
          total_passed = total_passed + 1
        else
          print("  ❌ FAIL: " + name)
          total_failed = total_failed + 1
        end

        i = i + 1
      end

      print("")
      gi = gi + 1
    end

    let total = total_passed + total_failed
    print("=== 결과: " + int_to_str(total_passed) + "/" + int_to_str(total) + " 통과 ===")

    if total_failed == 0
      print("✅ 모든 테스트 통과!")
    else
      print("❌ " + int_to_str(total_failed) + "개 실패")
    end
end

fn main(args: array<string>) -> i32
  do
    run_all_tests()
    return 0
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

// ============================================================
// ci_monitor.fl - CI 상태 모니터링 & 폴링 (Phase 3)
// GOGS + 외부 CI(GitHub Actions 스타일) 상태 대기
// 외부 라이브러리 없음
// ============================================================

struct CiStatus {
  state: string,       // "pending" | "running" | "success" | "failure" | "error" | "unknown"
  description: string,
  target_url: string,  // CI 로그 URL
  context: string,     // "ci/build" | "ci/test" 등
  updated_at: i64
}

struct CiPollConfig {
  repo: string,
  commit_sha: string,
  branch: string,
  max_wait_sec: i32,   // 최대 대기 초
  poll_interval: i32,  // 폴링 간격 초
  required_contexts: array  // 통과 필요한 CI 컨텍스트 이름들
}

struct CiWaitResult {
  success: bool,
  final_state: string,
  passed_contexts: array,
  failed_contexts: array,
  elapsed_sec: i32,
  timed_out: bool,
  ci_log_url: string
}

// ==================== 메인 대기 루프 ====================

fn wait_for_ci(client: GogsClient, cfg: CiPollConfig) -> CiWaitResult
  intent "CI 완료까지 폴링 대기"
  do
    print("[CI] 대기 시작: " + cfg.repo + "#" + str_substr(cfg.commit_sha, 0, 8))
    print("[CI] 최대 대기: " + int_to_str(cfg.max_wait_sec) + "초 / 간격: " + int_to_str(cfg.poll_interval) + "초")

    let start_time = now_unix()
    let elapsed = 0
    let attempt = 0

    while elapsed < cfg.max_wait_sec
      attempt = attempt + 1
      elapsed = now_unix() - start_time

      // CI 상태 조회
      let statuses = get_commit_statuses(client, cfg.repo, cfg.commit_sha)

      if arr_len(statuses) > 0
        let result = evaluate_ci_statuses(statuses, cfg.required_contexts)

        print("[CI] " + int_to_str(elapsed) + "s | " + result.summary)

        if result.all_done
          return CiWaitResult {
            success: result.all_passed,
            final_state: if result.all_passed "success" else "failure",
            passed_contexts: result.passed,
            failed_contexts: result.failed,
            elapsed_sec: elapsed,
            timed_out: false,
            ci_log_url: get_ci_log_url(statuses)
          }
        end
      else
        // CI가 아직 시작 안 됨
        print("[CI] " + int_to_str(elapsed) + "s | CI 대기 중...")
      end

      // 대기
      sleep_sec(cfg.poll_interval)
    end

    // 타임아웃
    print("[CI] 타임아웃: " + int_to_str(cfg.max_wait_sec) + "초 초과")

    let last_statuses = get_commit_statuses(client, cfg.repo, cfg.commit_sha)
    let last_eval = evaluate_ci_statuses(last_statuses, cfg.required_contexts)

    return CiWaitResult {
      success: false,
      final_state: "timeout",
      passed_contexts: last_eval.passed,
      failed_contexts: last_eval.failed,
      elapsed_sec: cfg.max_wait_sec,
      timed_out: true,
      ci_log_url: ""
    }
end

// ==================== 상태 조회 ====================

fn get_commit_statuses(client: GogsClient, repo: string, sha: string) -> array
  intent "커밋 CI 상태 목록 조회 (GOGS API)"
  do
    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo +
              "/statuses/" + sha + "?token=" + client.token

    match curl_get(url)
      Err(_) => return []
      Ok(resp) => return parse_status_array(resp)
    end
end

fn get_combined_status(client: GogsClient, repo: string, sha: string) -> CiStatus
  intent "커밋 종합 CI 상태 조회"
  do
    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo +
              "/commits/" + sha + "/status?token=" + client.token

    match curl_get(url)
      Err(_) => {
        return CiStatus {
          state: "unknown",
          description: "조회 실패",
          target_url: "",
          context: "",
          updated_at: 0
        }
      }
      Ok(resp) => {
        let state = json_extract_string(resp, "state")
        if state == ""
          state = "unknown"
        end
        return CiStatus {
          state: state,
          description: json_extract_string(resp, "message"),
          target_url: "",
          context: "combined",
          updated_at: 0
        }
      }
    end
end

fn create_commit_status(client: GogsClient, repo: string, sha: string, state: string, desc: string, context: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "커밋 CI 상태 업데이트 (self-healing 결과 보고용)"
  do
    let body = "{\"state\":\"" + state + "\"," +
               "\"description\":\"" + json_escape(desc) + "\"," +
               "\"context\":\"" + json_escape(context) + "\"}"

    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo + "/statuses/" + sha

    match curl_post_auth(url, body, client.token)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("상태 업데이트 실패: " + e)
    end
end

// ==================== 상태 평가 ====================

struct CiEvalResult {
  all_done: bool,
  all_passed: bool,
  passed: array,
  failed: array,
  pending: array,
  summary: string
}

fn evaluate_ci_statuses(statuses: array, required: array) -> CiEvalResult
  intent "CI 상태 목록 평가 - 완료 여부 + 통과 여부"
  do
    let passed = []
    let failed = []
    let pending = []
    let n = arr_len(statuses)
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let status = arr_get(statuses, i)
      let state = status.state
      let ctx = status.context

      if state == "success"
        passed = arr_push(passed, ctx)
      else if state == "failure" || state == "error"
        failed = arr_push(failed, ctx)
      else
        pending = arr_push(pending, ctx)  // pending, running
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    // required contexts 체크
    let required_all_passed = true
    let ri = 0
    let rn = arr_len(required)

    while ri < rn
      let req = arr_get(required, ri)
      if !arr_contains_str(passed, req)
        required_all_passed = false
      end
      ri = ri + 1
    end

    let all_done = arr_len(pending) == 0
    let all_passed = required_all_passed && arr_len(failed) == 0

    let summary = "✅" + int_to_str(arr_len(passed)) +
                  " ❌" + int_to_str(arr_len(failed)) +
                  " ⏳" + int_to_str(arr_len(pending))

    return CiEvalResult {
      all_done: all_done,
      all_passed: all_passed,
      passed: passed,
      failed: failed,
      pending: pending,
      summary: summary
    }
end

fn is_ci_terminal_state(state: string) -> bool
  intent "CI 상태가 최종 상태인지 확인"
  do
    return state == "success" || state == "failure" ||
           state == "error" || state == "cancelled"
end

// ==================== 응답 파서 ====================

fn parse_status_array(json: string) -> array
  intent "CI 상태 JSON 배열 파싱"
  do
    let result = []

    if !str_contains(json, "[")
      return result
    end

    // 각 상태 객체 추출
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(json)
    let depth = 0
    let obj_start = -1

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(json, i)

      if ch == "{"
        if depth == 0
          obj_start = i
        end
        depth = depth + 1
      else if ch == "}"
        depth = depth - 1
        if depth == 0 && obj_start >= 0
          let obj = str_substr(json, obj_start, i + 1)
          let status = parse_single_status(obj)
          if status.state != ""
            result = arr_push(result, status)
          end
          obj_start = -1
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return result
end

fn parse_single_status(json: string) -> CiStatus
  intent "단일 CI 상태 JSON 파싱"
  do
    let state = json_extract_string(json, "state")
    let desc = json_extract_string(json, "description")
    let url = json_extract_string(json, "target_url")
    let context = json_extract_string(json, "context")

    if state == ""
      state = "unknown"
    end
    if context == ""
      context = "ci/default"
    end

    return CiStatus {
      state: state,
      description: desc,
      target_url: url,
      context: context,
      updated_at: 0
    }
end

fn get_ci_log_url(statuses: array) -> string
  intent "CI 로그 URL 추출 (실패한 것 우선)"
  do
    let n = arr_len(statuses)
    let i = 0
    let fallback = ""

    while i < n
      let s = arr_get(statuses, i)
      if s.target_url != ""
        fallback = s.target_url
        if s.state == "failure" || s.state == "error"
          return s.target_url
        end
      end
      i = i + 1
    end

    return fallback
end

// ==================== CI 설정 빌더 ====================

fn default_ci_poll_config(repo: string, sha: string, branch: string) -> CiPollConfig
  intent "기본 CI 폴링 설정"
  do
    return CiPollConfig {

// ============================================================
// ci_monitor.fl - CI 상태 모니터링 & 폴링 (Phase 3)
// GOGS + 외부 CI(GitHub Actions 스타일) 상태 대기
// 외부 라이브러리 없음
// ============================================================

struct CiStatus {
  state: string,       // "pending" | "running" | "success" | "failure" | "error" | "unknown"
  description: string,
  target_url: string,  // CI 로그 URL
  context: string,     // "ci/build" | "ci/test" 등
  updated_at: i64
}

struct CiPollConfig {
  repo: string,
  commit_sha: string,
  branch: string,
  max_wait_sec: i32,   // 최대 대기 초
  poll_interval: i32,  // 폴링 간격 초
  required_contexts: array  // 통과 필요한 CI 컨텍스트 이름들
}

struct CiWaitResult {
  success: bool,
  final_state: string,
  passed_contexts: array,
  failed_contexts: array,
  elapsed_sec: i32,
  timed_out: bool,
  ci_log_url: string
}

// ==================== 메인 대기 루프 ====================

fn wait_for_ci(client: GogsClient, cfg: CiPollConfig) -> CiWaitResult
  intent "CI 완료까지 폴링 대기"
  do
    print("[CI] 대기 시작: " + cfg.repo + "#" + str_substr(cfg.commit_sha, 0, 8))
    print("[CI] 최대 대기: " + int_to_str(cfg.max_wait_sec) + "초 / 간격: " + int_to_str(cfg.poll_interval) + "초")

    let start_time = now_unix()
    let elapsed = 0
    let attempt = 0

    while elapsed < cfg.max_wait_sec
      attempt = attempt + 1
      elapsed = now_unix() - start_time

      // CI 상태 조회
      let statuses = get_commit_statuses(client, cfg.repo, cfg.commit_sha)

      if arr_len(statuses) > 0
        let result = evaluate_ci_statuses(statuses, cfg.required_contexts)

        print("[CI] " + int_to_str(elapsed) + "s | " + result.summary)

        if result.all_done
          return CiWaitResult {
            success: result.all_passed,
            final_state: if result.all_passed "success" else "failure",
            passed_contexts: result.passed,
            failed_contexts: result.failed,
            elapsed_sec: elapsed,
            timed_out: false,
            ci_log_url: get_ci_log_url(statuses)
          }
        end
      else
        // CI가 아직 시작 안 됨
        print("[CI] " + int_to_str(elapsed) + "s | CI 대기 중...")
      end

      // 대기
      sleep_sec(cfg.poll_interval)
    end

    // 타임아웃
    print("[CI] 타임아웃: " + int_to_str(cfg.max_wait_sec) + "초 초과")

    let last_statuses = get_commit_statuses(client, cfg.repo, cfg.commit_sha)
    let last_eval = evaluate_ci_statuses(last_statuses, cfg.required_contexts)

    return CiWaitResult {
      success: false,
      final_state: "timeout",
      passed_contexts: last_eval.passed,
      failed_contexts: last_eval.failed,
      elapsed_sec: cfg.max_wait_sec,
      timed_out: true,
      ci_log_url: ""
    }
end

// ==================== 상태 조회 ====================

fn get_commit_statuses(client: GogsClient, repo: string, sha: string) -> array
  intent "커밋 CI 상태 목록 조회 (GOGS API)"
  do
    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo +
              "/statuses/" + sha + "?token=" + client.token

    match curl_get(url)
      Err(_) => return []
      Ok(resp) => return parse_status_array(resp)
    end
end

fn get_combined_status(client: GogsClient, repo: string, sha: string) -> CiStatus
  intent "커밋 종합 CI 상태 조회"
  do
    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo +
              "/commits/" + sha + "/status?token=" + client.token

    match curl_get(url)
      Err(_) => {
        return CiStatus {
          state: "unknown",
          description: "조회 실패",
          target_url: "",
          context: "",
          updated_at: 0
        }
      }
      Ok(resp) => {
        let state = json_extract_string(resp, "state")
        if state == ""
          state = "unknown"
        end
        return CiStatus {
          state: state,
          description: json_extract_string(resp, "message"),
          target_url: "",
          context: "combined",
          updated_at: 0
        }
      }
    end
end

fn create_commit_status(client: GogsClient, repo: string, sha: string, state: string, desc: string, context: string) -> Result<void, string>
  intent "커밋 CI 상태 업데이트 (self-healing 결과 보고용)"

    let body = "{\"state\":\"" + state + "\"," +
               "\"description\":\"" + json_escape(desc) + "\"," +
               "\"context\":\"" + json_escape(context) + "\"}"

    let url = client.base_url + "/api/v1/repos/" +
              client.owner + "/" + repo + "/statuses/" + sha

    match curl_post_auth(url, body, client.token)
      Ok(_) => return Ok(void)
      Err(e) => return Err("상태 업데이트 실패: " + e)
    end
end

  all_passed: bool,
  passed: array,

  pending: array,
  summary: string

  do
    let passed = []
    let failed = []
    let pending = []
    let n = arr_len(statuses)
    let i = 0

    while i < n
      let status = arr_get(statuses, i)
      let state = status.state
      let ctx = status.context

      if state == "success"
        passed = arr_push(passed, ctx)
      else if state == "failure" || state == "error"
        failed = arr_push(failed, ctx)
      else
        pending = arr_push(pending, ctx)  // pending, running
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    // required contexts 체크
    let required_all_passed = true
    let ri = 0
    let rn = arr_len(required)

    while ri < rn
      let req = arr_get(required, ri)
      if !arr_contains_str(passed, req)
        required_all_passed = false
      end
      ri = ri + 1
    end

    let all_done = arr_len(pending) == 0
    let all_passed = required_all_passed && arr_len(failed) == 0

    let summary = "✅" + int_to_str(arr_len(passed)) +
                  " ❌" + int_to_str(arr_len(failed)) +
                  " ⏳" + int_to_str(arr_len(pending))

    return CiEvalResult {
      all_done: all_done,
      all_passed: all_passed,
      passed: passed,
      failed: failed,
      pending: pending,
      summary: summary
    }
end

fn is_ci_terminal_state(state: string) -> bool
  intent "CI 상태가 최종 상태인지 확인"
  do
    return state == "success" || state == "failure" ||
           state == "error" || state == "cancelled"

fn parse_status_array(json: string) -> array
  intent "CI 상태 JSON 배열 파싱"
  do
    let result = []

      return result
    end

    // 각 상태 객체 추출
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(json)
    let depth = 0
    let obj_start = -1

    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(json, i)

      if ch == "{"
        if depth == 0
          obj_start = i
        end
        depth = depth + 1
      else if ch == "}"
        depth = depth - 1
        if depth == 0 && obj_start >= 0
          let obj = str_substr(json, obj_start, i + 1)
          let status = parse_single_status(obj)
          if status.state != ""
            result = arr_push(result, status)
          end
          obj_start = -1
        end
      end

      i = i + 1
    end

    return result

fn parse_single_status(json: string) -> CiStatus
  intent "단일 CI 상태 JSON 파싱"
  do

    let desc = json_extract_string(json, "description")
    let url = json_extract_string(json, "target_url")
    let context = json_extract_string(json, "context")

    if state == ""
      state = "unknown"
    end
    if context == ""
      context = "ci/default"
    end

      state: state,
      description: desc,
      target_url: url,
      context: context,
      updated_at: 0
    }
end

  intent "CI 로그 URL 추출 (실패한 것 우선)"
  do
    let n = arr_len(statuses)

    let fallback = ""

        if s.state == "failure" || s.state == "error"

        end

      i = i + 1

// ============================================================
// auto_merge.fl - 자동 머지 엔진 (Phase 3)
// PR CI 통과 확인 → 조건 검사 → 자동 병합 → 브랜치 정리
// ============================================================

struct MergePolicy {
  require_ci_pass: bool,       // CI 통과 필수
  require_claude_approval: bool, // Claude 검증 통과 필수
  require_no_conflict: bool,   // 충돌 없음 필수
  min_proof_score: i32,        // 최소 ProofScore (0-100)
  auto_delete_branch: bool,    // 머지 후 브랜치 자동 삭제
  merge_method: string,        // "merge" | "squash" | "rebase"
  max_ci_wait_sec: i32         // CI 대기 최대 시간
}

struct MergeResult {
  success: bool,
  pr_number: i32,
  merge_sha: string,           // 머지 커밋 SHA
  merge_method: string,
  branch_deleted: bool,
  reason: string,              // 성공/실패 이유
  duration_sec: i32
}

struct MergeDecision {
  should_merge: bool,
  reason: string,
  blocking_reasons: array,     // 차단 이유 목록
  proof_score: i32
}

// ==================== 메인 자동 머지 ====================

fn auto_merge(
  client: GogsClient,
  repo: string,
  pr: GogsPR,
  policy: MergePolicy,
  proof_score: i32,
  verify_result: VerifyResult
) -> MergeResult
  intent "PR 자동 머지 파이프라인"
  do
    let start_time = now_unix()
    print("[AutoMerge] PR #" + int_to_str(pr.number) + " 자동 머지 평가 시작")

    // ─── Step 1: 머지 조건 평가 ──────────────────────────
    let decision = evaluate_merge_decision(pr, policy, proof_score, verify_result)

    if !decision.should_merge
      print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 머지 조건 미충족:")
      let i = 0
      let n = arr_len(decision.blocking_reasons)
      while i < n
        print("[AutoMerge]   - " + arr_get(decision.blocking_reasons, i))
        i = i + 1
      end

      return MergeResult {
        success: false,
        pr_number: pr.number,
        merge_sha: "",
        merge_method: "",
        branch_deleted: false,
        reason: "조건 미충족: " + format_blocking_reasons(decision.blocking_reasons),
        duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
      }
    end

    print("[AutoMerge] ✅ 조건 충족 (ProofScore: " + int_to_str(proof_score) + ") - 머지 진행")

    // ─── Step 2: CI 상태 대기 ────────────────────────────
    if policy.require_ci_pass
      print("[AutoMerge] CI 상태 대기 중...")

      let poll_cfg = CiPollConfig {
        repo: repo,
        commit_sha: pr.head_sha,
        branch: pr.head_branch,
        max_wait_sec: policy.max_ci_wait_sec,
        poll_interval: 15,
        required_contexts: []
      }

      let ci_result = wait_for_ci(client, poll_cfg)

      if !ci_result.success
        let ci_reason = if ci_result.timed_out
          "CI 타임아웃 (" + int_to_str(policy.max_ci_wait_sec) + "초)"
        else
          "CI 실패: " + format_list(ci_result.failed_contexts)

        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ CI 미통과: " + ci_reason)

        // CI 실패 코멘트
        gogs_add_pr_comment(client, repo, pr.number,
          "❌ **자동 머지 취소** - " + ci_reason + "\n\n" +
          "Self-Healing Agent가 패치를 생성했지만 CI가 통과하지 못했습니다.\n" +
          "수동으로 확인 후 머지해주세요.")

        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: "",
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: ci_reason,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      end

      print("[AutoMerge] ✅ CI 통과!")
    end

    // ─── Step 3: 충돌 확인 ───────────────────────────────
    if policy.require_no_conflict
      let conflict_check = check_merge_conflict(client, repo, pr)
      if conflict_check
        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 충돌 감지")
        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: "",
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: "머지 충돌 감지",
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      end
    end

    // ─── Step 4: 머지 실행 ───────────────────────────────
    let merge_msg = build_merge_message(pr, proof_score, policy.merge_method)
    print("[AutoMerge] 머지 실행 (" + policy.merge_method + ")...")

    let merge_result = gogs_merge_pr(client, repo, pr.number, merge_msg)

    match merge_result
      Err(e) => {
        print("[AutoMerge] ❌ 머지 실패: " + e)
        return MergeResult {
          success: false,
          pr_number: pr.number,
          merge_sha: "",
          merge_method: policy.merge_method,
          branch_deleted: false,
          reason: "머지 실패: " + e,
          duration_sec: now_unix() - start_time
        }
      }
      Ok(_) => {
        print("[AutoMerge] ✅ 머지 성공!")

        // ─── Step 5: 브랜치 정리 ─────────────────────────
        let branch_deleted = false
        if policy.auto_delete_branch && pr.head_branch != ""
          match gogs_delete_branch(client, repo, pr.head_branch)
            Ok(_) => {
              branch_deleted = true
              print("[AutoMerge] 브랜치 삭제: " + pr.head_branch)
            }
            Err(e) => {
              print("[AutoMerge] 브랜치 삭제 실패 (무시): " + e)
            }
          end
        end

fn format_list(arr: array) -> string

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string

    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num

    while num > 0

      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result

    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result

    return "#439FE0"  // 파랑

fn generate_daily_report(log_path: string) -> string
  intent "일일 자가치유 통계 리포트 생성"
  do
    match file_read(log_path)
      Err(_) => return "로그 파일 없음"
      Ok(content) => {
        let lines = str_split_lines(content)
        let total = arr_len(lines)
        let today_ts = now_unix() - 86400  // 24시간 전

        let started = 0
        let pr_created = 0
        let merged = 0
        let failed = 0
        let total_score = 0
        let score_count = 0

        let i = 0
        while i < total
          let line = str_trim(arr_get(lines, i))
          if str_len(line) == 0
            i = i + 1
            continue
          end

          // 오늘 로그만
          let ts = json_extract_int64(line, "ts")
          if ts < today_ts
            i = i + 1
            continue
          end

          let event = json_extract_string(line, "event")
          if event == "started" started = started + 1
          else if event == "pr_created" pr_created = pr_created + 1
          else if event == "merged"
            merged = merged + 1
            let score = json_extract_int(line, "proof_score")
            if score > 0
              total_score = total_score + score
              score_count = score_count + 1
            end
          else if event == "failed" failed = failed + 1

          i = i + 1
        end

        let avg_score = 0
        if score_count > 0
          avg_score = total_score / score_count
        end

        let success_rate = 0
        if started > 0
          success_rate = (merged * 100) / started
        end

        let report = "=== Self-Healing 일일 리포트 ===\n"
        report = report + "  시작: " + int_to_str(started) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  PR 생성: " + int_to_str(pr_created) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  자동 머지: " + int_to_str(merged) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  실패: " + int_to_str(failed) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  성공률: " + int_to_str(success_rate) + "%\n"
        report = report + "  평균 ProofScore: " + int_to_str(avg_score) + "/100\n"

        return report
      }
    end
end

      gogs_comment: true,
      console_output: true
    }

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\"" return result
        else result = result + ch
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
          result = result + ch
        else break
        i = i + 1
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(result)
    end
    return 0
end

fn json_extract_int64(json: string, key: string) -> i64
  do
    return json_extract_int(json, key)  // i32로 처리 (타임스탬프 범위 내)
end

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'" result = result + "'\\''"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end

    json = json + "\"attempts\":" + int_to_str(n.attempts) + ","
    json = json + "\"duration_sec\":" + int_to_str(n.duration_sec) + ","
    json = json + "\"error_type\":\"" + json_escape(n.error_type) + "\","
    json = json + "\"error_file\":\"" + json_escape(n.error_file) + "\","
    json = json + "\"summary\":\"" + json_escape(n.summary) + "\""
    json = json + "}"
    return json
end

// ==================== 콘솔 출력 ====================

fn print_notification(n: HealNotification) -> void
  intent "알림을 콘솔에 출력"
  do
    let icon = event_icon(n.event_type)
    let time_str = unix_to_time_str(n.timestamp)

    print("")
    print("┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────")
    print("│ " + icon + " [" + n.event_type + "] " + time_str)
    print("│ 세션: " + n.session_id)

    if n.repo != ""
      print("│ 저장소: " + n.repo + "/" + n.branch)
    end

    if n.pr_url != ""
      print("│ PR: " + n.pr_url)
    end

    if n.merge_sha != ""
      print("│ 머지 SHA: " + str_substr(n.merge_sha, 0, 8))
    end

    if n.proof_score > 0
      print("│ ProofScore: " + int_to_str(n.proof_score) + "/100")
    end

    if n.attempts > 0
      print("│ 시도: " + int_to_str(n.attempts) + "회")
    end

    if n.duration_sec > 0
      print("│ 소요: " + int_to_str(n.duration_sec) + "초")
    end

    print("│ " + n.summary)
    print("└─────────────────────────────────────────────────")
end

fn event_icon(event_type: string) -> string
  do
    if event_type == "started" return "🚀"
    if event_type == "pr_created" return "📬"
    if event_type == "merged" return "✅"
    if event_type == "failed" return "❌"
    if event_type == "skipped" return "⏭️"
    return "ℹ️"
end

fn unix_to_time_str(ts: i64) -> string
  intent "Unix timestamp를 간단한 시간 문자열로 변환"
  do
    // date 명령 활용
    let cmd = "date -d @" + int_to_str(ts) + " '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' 2>/dev/null || date -r " + int_to_str(ts) + " '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'"
    match exec(cmd)
      Ok(result) => return str_trim(result)
      Err(_) => return int_to_str(ts)
    end
end

// ==================== Webhook 전송 ====================

fn send_webhook(url: string, n: HealNotification) -> void
  intent "외부 Webhook으로 알림 전송"
  do
    let body = build_webhook_body(n)
    let cmd = "curl -s -X POST" +
              " -H 'Content-Type: application/json'" +
              " -d '" + shell_escape_single(body) + "'" +
              " '" + url + "' >/dev/null 2>&1"
    exec(cmd)
end

fn build_webhook_body(n: HealNotification) -> string
  intent "Webhook 페이로드 생성 (Slack 호환 형식)"
  do
    let icon = event_icon(n.event_type)
    let color = webhook_color(n.event_type)
    let title = icon + " Self-Healing: " + n.event_type

    let text = n.summary
    if n.proof_score > 0
      text = text + " | ProofScore: " + int_to_str(n.proof_score) + "/100"
    end
    if n.pr_url != ""
      text = text + " | PR: " + n.pr_url
    end

    // Slack attachment 형식
    let body = "{\"attachments\":[{" +
               "\"color\":\"" + color + "\"," +
               "\"title\":\"" + json_escape(title) + "\"," +
               "\"text\":\"" + json_escape(text) + "\"," +
               "\"footer\":\"Self-Healing Agent\"," +
               "\"ts\":" + int_to_str(n.timestamp) +
               "}]}"

    return body
end

fn webhook_color(event_type: string) -> string
  do
    if event_type == "merged" return "good"    // 초록
    if event_type == "failed" return "danger"  // 빨강
    if event_type == "pr_created" return "warning"  // 노랑
    return "#439FE0"  // 파랑
end

// ==================== 통계 리포트 ====================

fn generate_daily_report(log_path: string) -> string
  intent "일일 자가치유 통계 리포트 생성"
  do
    match file_read(log_path)
      Err(_) => return "로그 파일 없음"
      Ok(content) => {
        let lines = str_split_lines(content)
        let total = arr_len(lines)
        let today_ts = now_unix() - 86400  // 24시간 전

        let started = 0
        let pr_created = 0
        let merged = 0
        let failed = 0
        let total_score = 0
        let score_count = 0

        let i = 0
        while i < total
          let line = str_trim(arr_get(lines, i))
          if str_len(line) == 0
            i = i + 1
            continue
          end

          // 오늘 로그만
          let ts = json_extract_int64(line, "ts")
          if ts < today_ts
            i = i + 1
            continue
          end

          let event = json_extract_string(line, "event")
          if event == "started" started = started + 1
          else if event == "pr_created" pr_created = pr_created + 1
          else if event == "merged"
            merged = merged + 1
            let score = json_extract_int(line, "proof_score")
            if score > 0
              total_score = total_score + score
              score_count = score_count + 1
            end
          else if event == "failed" failed = failed + 1

          i = i + 1
        end

        let avg_score = 0
        if score_count > 0
          avg_score = total_score / score_count
        end

        let success_rate = 0
        if started > 0
          success_rate = (merged * 100) / started
        end

        let report = "=== Self-Healing 일일 리포트 ===\n"
        report = report + "  시작: " + int_to_str(started) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  PR 생성: " + int_to_str(pr_created) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  자동 머지: " + int_to_str(merged) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  실패: " + int_to_str(failed) + "회\n"
        report = report + "  성공률: " + int_to_str(success_rate) + "%\n"
        report = report + "  평균 ProofScore: " + int_to_str(avg_score) + "/100\n"

        return report
      }
    end
end

// ==================== 알림 설정 ====================

fn default_notify_config(log_path: string) -> NotifyConfig
  intent "기본 알림 설정 (로그+콘솔만)"
  do
    return NotifyConfig {
      log_path: log_path,
      webhook_url: "",
      webhook_enabled: false,
      gogs_comment: true,
      console_output: true
    }
end

fn notify_config_with_webhook(log_path: string, webhook_url: string) -> NotifyConfig
  intent "Webhook 포함 알림 설정"
  do
    return NotifyConfig {
      log_path: log_path,
      webhook_url: webhook_url,
      webhook_enabled: true,
      gogs_comment: true,
      console_output: true
    }
end

// ==================== 헬퍼 ====================

fn json_extract_string(json: string, key: string) -> string
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":\""
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_after(json, search)
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "\\" i = i + 1
        else if ch == "\"" return result
        else result = result + ch
        i = i + 1
      end
    end
    return ""
end

fn json_extract_int(json: string, key: string) -> i32
  do
    let search = "\"" + key + "\":"
    if str_contains(json, search)
      let after = str_trim(str_after(json, search))
      let result = ""
      let i = 0
      let len = str_len(after)
      while i < len
        let ch = str_char(after, i)
        if ch == "0" || ch == "1" || ch == "2" || ch == "3" || ch == "4" ||
           ch == "5" || ch == "6" || ch == "7" || ch == "8" || ch == "9"
          result = result + ch
        else break
        i = i + 1
      end
      return parse_int_from_str(result)
    end
    return 0
end

fn json_extract_int64(json: string, key: string) -> i64
  do
    return json_extract_int(json, key)  // i32로 처리 (타임스탬프 범위 내)
end

fn json_escape(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "\"" result = result + "\\\""
      else if ch == "\\" result = result + "\\\\"
      else if ch == "\n" result = result + "\\n"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn shell_escape_single(s: string) -> string
  do
    let result = ""
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "'" result = result + "'\\''"
      else result = result + ch
      i = i + 1
    end
    return result
end

fn parse_int_from_str(s: string) -> i32
  do
    let num = 0
    let i = 0
    let len = str_len(s)
    while i < len
      let ch = str_char(s, i)
      if ch == "0" num = num * 10
      else if ch == "1" num = num * 10 + 1
      else if ch == "2" num = num * 10 + 2
      else if ch == "3" num = num * 10 + 3
      else if ch == "4" num = num * 10 + 4
      else if ch == "5" num = num * 10 + 5
      else if ch == "6" num = num * 10 + 6
      else if ch == "7" num = num * 10 + 7
      else if ch == "8" num = num * 10 + 8
      else if ch == "9" num = num * 10 + 9
      else return num
      i = i + 1
    end
    return num
end

fn int_to_str(n: i32) -> string
  do
    if n == 0 return "0"
    let result = ""
    let num = n
    let neg = false
    if num < 0
      neg = true
      num = 0 - num
    end
    while num > 0
      let d = num % 10
      if d == 0 result = "0" + result
      if d == 1 result = "1" + result
      if d == 2 result = "2" + result
      if d == 3 result = "3" + result
      if d == 4 result = "4" + result
      if d == 5 result = "5" + result
      if d == 6 result = "6" + result
      if d == 7 result = "7" + result
      if d == 8 result = "8" + result
      if d == 9 result = "9" + result
      num = num / 10
    end
    if neg result = "-" + result
    return result
end
